fit_reason: This is an ad renting outdoor storage space, not a private owner selling a vehicle or boat. The truck and covered boats in the photos are just items being stored, not for sale.
message: Hi, we saw your storage space listing. We're a small local detailing team that does cars and boats, including gelcoat polish and pre-sale details, and we come to you. If any of your renters ever want their vehicle or boat cleaned up before pickup or a sale, would you be open to passing our name along?
